_README: Modules copied down from the simulation into live/engine/. Divergence is expected and allowed: live tuning must not perturb a simulation sample. What is NOT allowed is divergence nobody noticed, which is what live/tests/test_fork_drift.py reports. source_sha256 is over the file with CRLF normalised to LF, so a line-ending change alone does not trip it. When the root copy has genuinely moved, read the diff, decide whether the live copy wants the same change, then re-record with: python live/scripts/refork.py

live/engine/config.py.why: Leaf config -- live tuning parameters diverge from simulation: bankroll_usd=100.0, quote_shares=0 (dollar-sized), min_quote_shares=5 (venue min_size), max_naked_usd=6.0, couple_risk_frac=0.01, min_couple_usd=6.0.

live/engine/gate.py.why: Leaf module -- quality gate and fleet posture state machine -- so live/ decision layer carries its own copy.

live/engine/markets.py.why: Leaf module -- stdlib plus requests only -- so live/ can carry its own copy instead of importing across the tree boundary.

live/engine/quotes.py.why: Decision layer -- decide_quotes() with live dynamic dollar sizing ($3/leg budget), explicit shortfall refusal reporting, and 5-share venue floor.

live/engine/risk.py.why: Leaf module -- dollar risk, skew offsets, size ladder with dynamic dollar sizing support (quote_shares == 0 derives shares from leg budget / price), and $6 naked cap.
